name: whybrary
description: A local-first personal why manager with a neuron-style graph and lightweight To-Do lists.

scripts.android:init: powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File scripts/android-env.ps1 tauri android init
scripts.android:init:ci: powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File scripts/android-env.ps1 tauri android init --ci --skip-targets-install
scripts.android:prepare: npm run android:init:ci && npm run android:mirror
scripts.android:rust:release:aarch64: powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File scripts/android-env.ps1 powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File scripts/android-build-rust.ps1 -Target aarch64 -Release
scripts.android:rust:release:armv7: powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File scripts/android-env.ps1 powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File scripts/android-build-rust.ps1 -Target armv7 -Release
scripts.android:rust:release:i686: powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File scripts/android-env.ps1 powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File scripts/android-build-rust.ps1 -Target i686 -Release
scripts.android:rust:release:x86_64: powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File scripts/android-env.ps1 powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File scripts/android-build-rust.ps1 -Target x86_64 -Release
scripts.android:sign:apk: powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File scripts/android-env.ps1 powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File scripts/android-sign-apk.ps1
scripts.android:dev: powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File scripts/android-env.ps1 powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File scripts/android-dev.ps1
scripts.android:gradle:debug: powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File scripts/android-env.ps1 powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File scripts/android-gradle-debug.ps1
scripts.android:gradle:apk: powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File scripts/android-env.ps1 powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File scripts/android-gradle-apk.ps1
scripts.android:build:signed: npm run android:build:apk && npm run android:sign:apk
scripts.android:run: powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File scripts/android-env.ps1 powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File scripts/android-run.ps1
